vision: Build an enterprise-grade intelligent code and architectural quality gate system that automates end-to-end compliance and invariant enforcement from ambiguous requirements to production release.
core_pain_points: Critical business invariants are frequently broken during refactoring and high-frequency iterations, causing catastrophic financial losses and production incidents
PRDs lack formal state machine and exception recovery specifications, causing misalignment between engineering and QA
Requirement modifications lack end-to-end bidirectional lineage traceability, preventing automated regression
budget_and_timeline: Launch in Q3, deliver MVP pilot rollout across 5 tier-1 enterprises within 6 months

stakeholders.concern: Delivery quality and compliance risk mitigation
PRD formalization and elimination of requirement reconciliation disputes
100% test scenario coverage over product invariants
